translations.zh: 太宗即位，擢禦龍直指揮使。
translations.literal: When Taizong ascended the throne, Qiong was promoted to commander of the Imperial Dragon Straight Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, Qiong was promoted to commander of the Imperial Dragon Straight Guard.

translations.zh: 從征太原，命押弓弩兩班，合圍攻城。
translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Taiyuan and was ordered to command the two companies of bowmen and crossbowmen in encircling the city for assault.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Taiyuan and was ordered to command the two companies of bowmen and crossbowmen in encircling the city for assault.

translations.zh: 及討幽薊，屬車駕倍道還，留瓊與軍中鼓吹殿後，六班扈從不及，惟瓊首率所部見行在，太宗大悅，慰勞之。
translations.literal: When the campaign against You and Ji was launched, the imperial procession made a forced march back. Qiong was left with the army musicians as rearguard; the Six Companies could not keep up, but only Qiong was first to lead his troops to the traveling palace. Taizong was greatly pleased and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against You and Ji, the imperial procession made a forced march back. Qiong was left with the army musicians as rearguard; the Six Companies could not keep pace, but Qiong alone was first to lead his troops to the traveling palace. Taizong was greatly pleased and rewarded him.

translations.zh: 太平興國四年，遷天武都指揮使、領西州刺史。
translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo he was transferred to commander of the Heavenly Martial Guard and concurrently made military commissioner of Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo he was transferred to commander of the Heavenly Martial Guard and concurrently made military commissioner of Xizhou.

translations.zh: 明年，改為神衛右廂都指揮使、領本州團練使。
translations.literal: The following year he was changed to commander of the right wing of the Divine Guard and concurrently made military commissioner of his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was changed to commander of the right wing of the Divine Guard and concurrently made military commissioner of his prefecture.

translations.zh: 車駕巡師大名，命瓊與日騎右廂都指揮使朱守節分為京城內巡檢。
translations.literal: When the imperial procession inspected troops at Daming, Qiong was ordered together with Zhu Shoujie, commander of the right wing of the Day-Cavalry Guard, to serve jointly as inner capital inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession inspected troops at Daming, Qiong was ordered together with Zhu Shoujie, commander of the right wing of the Day-Cavalry Guard, to serve jointly as inner capital inspectors.

translations.zh: 坐事，出為許州馬步軍都指揮使。
translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to commander of cavalry and infantry at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was demoted to commander of cavalry and infantry at Xuzhou.
